Oh, why did you come back?\n...You wanna fight Mochelo?!
You won last time, but actually\nMochelo is very strong, you know?\nYou may get injured, seriously.
Are you OK with that?\n...Hmm, are you confident or just stupid?\nWhatever, I got it...
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
Hey, what brought you here?\n...What?! Defeat Flare Volg!?\nI told you many adventurers were beaten by it!
?! You've got... Star Hunter Flower?!\nThen, we might be able to make it.\nI guess I can back you up if you'd like.
...Huh? Well, I wanna get some rare gems too...\nNo worries, I'm good at fighting.\nHow does it sound?
Let's fight together!
I'm afraid I wanna fight alone.
Alright! Let's go!
Meh. Fine!\nYou'll be sorry for it later.\nWell, keep your guard up.
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Mochelo!!
Hi! Nice to meet you!\nI'm Shreya. Glad to see you.\nSo, you are Straye, aren't you?
I'm Straye, too and I'm broke now.\nCan you spare some money or supplies?
W-W-Wait, wait.\nStraye must help each other.\nThat's the rule, you know?
...Don't know that?!\nWere you born yesterday?\nJust stay back.
So, do you need money? Or supplies?\nEither one, we don't have much.
Well then... Just give me the luggage and...\neverything you have.\nMochelo! Come on!
Aieeee!! That's robbery!\nHey, you gotta do something!
Wow, you have a nice weapon.\nI'll take it, too. Thanks!\nGo get it, Mochelo!!
I know I can't get away with it but...\nPlease forgive me!
I don't want to but this adventurer said\nyou might have a compelling reason for stealing\nbelongings from the people in the same faction.
So, lemme hear you. Tell us why you used\nthat monster and tried to take our belongings?\nYour fate depends on your answer!
We're looking for a land to reestablish\nDiels-only country, which existed long time ago...
But I got separated from my friends & lost my bag.\nI haven't eaten anything for a few days.\nSo, I had to...
*sigh* You used the monster just because of that?\nWhat would the founder of your country,\nC..Cur...I forgot the name.
Whatever. She would be disappointed, right?
Yes...
So, what're you gonna do? ...Huh? Rule? Normally\nif you try to take things from Straye fellows\nby force, so your badge will be confiscated.
That's nice!
Forgive her
Oh, c'mon!!
No no no!\nYou don't understand what it means, do you?!
We, Straye people can receive support from other\ngroups because we have a badge, you know?
If the badge is taken, she won't be able to\nreceive aid anywhere and she'll die in a ditch!\nYou should take responsibility for your words!!
Well, when I was traveling in a caravan,\nI once got lost and wandered in hunger too...
Well, as a fellow Straye, I'll forgive you\nand forget this situation just for this time.
Here's some food. This should be enough until you\nreach the city. You can go now. But if you're\ndoing the same thing next time we meet...
Thaaanks! Then, I'll give you some info in return.\nYou shouldn't go deep into the volcano.
There's a fierce monster called Flare Volg.\nWe have no chance against it...
The monster has valuable gems infused with flame.\nMany adventurers went to get the gem but most of\nthem were beaten by it...
I heard that the monster hates Star Hunter\nFlower Pollen but the flowers aren't around\nhere...
You have other questions?\n...A Cule peddler who sells holy gems?\nI haven't seen that person.
If I had seen him, I would have attacked and...\nNo no! I mean I would have asked for help...
Hey, do you think Tolala told us a lie...?
If he sells holy gems...\nThen, he should be a Resistle.
Why don't you visit Douce Hamlet?\nThere're many Resistle people there...
Did you hear that? Let's go to Douce Hamlet.\nHurry, hurry!\nYou must find your fellows, okay?
I know, I know! Bye!\nUm... I'm so sorry for attacking you.\nAnd... Thank you!
T-Treasurrreee!!
The treasure box won't open.\nYou took a closer look at it and found a keyhole\non it.
Looks like we need a key to open it...
Ugggg... Ouch...\nWhat the heck is this...?
Huh? It's locked? Of course!
D-Don't say you've been ignoring these boxes...
...Oh my!
Then, remember. The legend says that there are\nCule's Treasure Boxes all over the world.
It also says the treasure of the legendary king\nof Cule scattered all over the world because of\nthe cataclysm...
Well, okay. At a time like this...
Cule's special Metamo Key!
Hey!! Why aren't you surprised?\nIt's very rare, you know?!
Only a few Cule tribes know how to make this key.
When you insert the key, the key transforms to fit\nthe keyhole. So, we can unlock any locks...
You must remember this.\nIt's a common knowledge for Straye, got it?
Oh, right!\nI should tell you the weakness of this key too.
The key can transform into any shape but\nit's very fragile.
It will be broken once we use it.
What? Then? Then, I'll just make a new key.\nI'm creating the keys in my spare time. Look.
Pelulu took out a bunch of keys and handed over\na few keys to you.
You got Metamo Keys!
Open the treasure boxes when you find them...
When they are gone? Let me know then.
But it takes time to make one key, so don't use\nthem easily, okay?
Okay, everyone managed to collect it... Hm?\nYea, we did it, too. Why? You'll see there.\nNow, guide us to the wormhole to Navida!
